description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within the request handling pipeline, ensuring that each request is processed within a transactional context, with commit, rollback, and exception handling.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for MediatR that manages database transactions during request processing.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles each request by beginning a transaction, calling the next delegate, committing the transaction if successful, or rolling back if an exception occurs.
